resolved_findings.resolution: Layer 2 temporarily hidden during hoist; previous visibility restored on completion. Notification updated at attachment and receipt. Corrected capture directly reinspected; behavioral checks passed.

limitations: Prepared engine states, not a continuous human playthrough.
Native Linux Compatibility renderer with Mesa; no Windows executable or browser playthrough is implied.
The two signature JPEG inspection derivatives are lossy; original PNGs and their hashes remain authoritative.
Procedural prototype geometry and materials; no final AAA asset or performance certification.
Options retain minor background transparency without a blocking readability issue.
